description: Durable run and lineage manifest for bronze/copper labeling windows. Prefect state tracks execution; this table tracks data processing decisions.
sql: SELECT CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS manifest_id, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS run_id, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS workflow_name, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS mode, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS fleet_name, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS pad_name, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS well_name, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS requested_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS requested_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS effective_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS effective_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS lookback_hours, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS chunk_hours, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS chunk_index, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_datastore_key, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS source_row_count, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_min_record_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_max_record_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS bronze_status, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS copper_status, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_index_status, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS rows_bronze_written, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS rows_copper_written, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_count_written, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS algorithm_version, CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS dry_run, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS status, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS error_message, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS started_at, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS completed_at FROM datastore:merged_fleet_stream_customer_full_v2 WHERE 1 = 0
